title: Sessionize a Clickstream in SQL
hints: LAG(click_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY click_ts) gives the previous click; a NULL (first click) or a gap > 30 minutes marks a new session.
A running SUM of that 0/1 flag, ordered by click_ts within the user, numbers the sessions 1, 2, 3, ...
Group by user_id and session_id for MIN, MAX and COUNT. A gap of exactly 30 minutes stays in the same session.
